subtitle: Every single second with you is my favorite memory.

photos.caption: Every laugh is sweeter by your side 🌹

specialReasons.title: My Whole World
specialReasons.desc: The effortless way you make every single day feel warm, magical, and full of peace.

specialReasons.title: Unconditional Grace
specialReasons.desc: Your gentle heart and the endless kindness you share with everyone around you.

specialReasons.title: Forever Partner
specialReasons.desc: Through every twist, journey, and victory, I choose you again and again every day.

letter.title: To My One & Only
letter.content:
My Love,

Looking back at our journey, every single second with you is my absolute favorite memory. You bring warmth, laughter, and an unspoken comfort into my life that nothing else could ever replace.

Thank you for choosing me, for holding my hand through everything, and for filling my heart with pure romance and peace. Here is to our forever.

Happy Anniversary, my soulmate! ❤️🌹
letter.signOff:
Forever yours,
Liam ❤️

Keep dreaming big, eating all the cake without counting calories, and shining brighter than everyone else in the room.

Love always,
Your forever cheerleaders 🥳💛
